data.evidence_sentence: Students who exhibit financial need are reviewed during the application process in consideration for need-based awards.
data.notes: List page with several awards. The named award appears as "Madonna Assistance Award" in the Financial Need-Based Awards table, with amount varied based on need and need-based grant assistance. No deadline, degree level, nationality, or field is stated for this award. Enrollment status is inferred from the statement that need-based awards are reviewed during the application process. The general page text on full-time degree-seeking students applies to the high-school and transfer merit awards, not clearly to this award.
